name: 16002 · Butler, PA
findings: ZIP 16002 (Butler) has 53 nonprofit organizations. 27 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 20 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (25% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 16002 (Butler) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 16002 (Butler) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 71% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 8 organizations here; 23% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Does that match what people here experience? Where do people find ways to volunteer now, including outside formal organizations?
